title: Jeremiah 50:7
text: They have been attacked by all those who came across them: and their attackers said, We are doing no wrong, because they have done evil against the Lord in whom is righteousness, against the Lord, the hope of their fathers.

title: Jeremiah 50:8
text: Go in flight out of Babylon, go out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and be like he-goats before the flocks.

title: Jeremiah 50:9
text: ¶For see, I am moving and sending up against Babylon a band of great nations from the north country: and they will put their armies in position against her; and from there she will be taken: their arrows will be like those of an expert man of war; not one will come back without getting its mark.

title: Jeremiah 50:10
text: And the wealth of Chaldaea will come into the hands of her attackers: all those who take her wealth will have enough, says the Lord.

title: Jeremiah 50:11
text: Because you are glad, because you are lifted up with pride, you wasters of my heritage, because you are playing like a young cow put out to grass, and you make a noise like strong horses;

title: Jeremiah 50:12
text: Your mother will be put to shame; she who gave you birth will be looked down on: see, she will be the last of the nations, a waste place, a dry and unwatered land.

title: Jeremiah 50:13
text: Because of the wrath of the Lord no one will be living in it, and it will be quite unpeopled: everyone who goes by Babylon will be overcome with wonder, and make sounds of fear at all her punishments.

title: Jeremiah 50:14
text: Put your armies in position against Babylon on every side, all you bowmen; let loose your arrows at her, not keeping any back: for she has done evil against the Lord.

title: Jeremiah 50:15
text: Give a loud cry against her on every side; she has given herself up, her supports are overturned, her walls are broken down: for it is the payment taken by the Lord; give her payment; as she has done, so do to her.

title: Jeremiah 50:16
text: Let the planter of seed be cut off from Babylon, and everyone using the curved blade at the time of the grain-cutting: for fear of the cruel sword, everyone will be turned to his people, everyone will go in flight to his land.

title: Jeremiah 50:17
text: Israel is a wandering sheep; the lions have been driving him away: first he was attacked by the king of Assyria, and now his bones have been broken by Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 50:18
text: So this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said: See, I will send punishment on the king of Babylon and on his land, as I have given punishment to the king of Assyria.

title: Jeremiah 50:19
text: And I will make Israel come back to his resting-place, and he will get his food on Carmel and Bashan, and have his desire in full measure on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.

title: Jeremiah 50:20
text: In those days and in that time, says the Lord, when the evil-doing of Israel is looked for, there will be nothing; and in Judah no sins will be seen: for I will have forgiveness for those whom I will keep safe.

title: Jeremiah 50:21
text: ¶Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the people of Pekod; put them to death and send destruction after them, says the Lord, and do everything I have given you orders to do.

title: Jeremiah 50:22
text: There is a sound of war in the land and of great destruction.

title: Jeremiah 50:23
text: How is the hammer of all the earth cut in two and broken! how has Babylon become a waste among the nations!

title: Jeremiah 50:24
text: I have put a net for you, and you have been taken, O Babylon, without your knowledge: you have been uncovered and taken because you were fighting against the Lord.

title: Jeremiah 50:25
text: From his store-house the Lord has taken the instruments of his wrath: for the Lord, the Lord of armies, has a work to do in the land of the Chaldaeans.

title: Jeremiah 50:26
text: Come up against her one and all, let her store-houses be broken open: make her into a mass of stones, give her to the curse, till there is nothing of her to be seen.

title: Jeremiah 50:27
text: Put all her oxen to the sword; let them go down to death: sorrow is theirs, for their day has come, the time of their punishment.

title: Jeremiah 50:28
text: The voice of those who are in flight, who have got away safe from the land of Babylon, to give news in Zion of punishment from the Lord our God, even payment for his Temple.

title: Jeremiah 50:29
text: Send for the archers to come together against Babylon, all the bowmen; put up your tents against her on every side; let no one get away: give her the reward of her work; as she has done, so do to her: for she has been uplifted in pride against the Lord, against the Holy One of Israel.

title: Jeremiah 50:30
text: For this cause her young men will be falling in her streets, and all her men of war will be cut off in that day, says the Lord.

title: Jeremiah 50:31
text: See, I am against you, O pride, says the Lord, the Lord of armies, for your day has come, the time when I will send punishment on you.

title: Jeremiah 50:32
text: And pride will go with uncertain steps and have a fall, and there will be no one to come to his help: and I will put a fire in his towns, burning up everything round about him.

title: Jeremiah 50:33
text: ¶This is what the Lord of armies has said: The children of Israel and the children of Judah are crushed down together: all those who took them prisoner keep them in a tight grip; they will not let them go.

title: Jeremiah 50:34
text: Their saviour is strong; the Lord of armies is his name: he will certainly take up their cause, so that he may give rest to the earth and trouble to the people of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 50:35
text: A sword is on the Chaldaeans, says the Lord, and on the people of Babylon, and on her rulers and on her wise men.

title: Jeremiah 50:36
text: A sword is on the men of pride, and they will become foolish: a sword is on her men of war, and they will be broken.

title: Jeremiah 50:37
text: A sword is on all the mixed people in her, and they will become like women: a sword is on her store-houses, and they will be taken by her attackers.

title: Jeremiah 50:38
text: A sword is on her waters, drying them up; for it is a land of images, and their minds are fixed on false gods.

title: Jeremiah 50:39
text: For this reason the beasts of the waste land with the wolves will make their holes there and the ostriches will be living in it: never again will men be living there, it will be unpeopled from generation to generation.

title: Jeremiah 50:40
text: As when Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighbouring towns were overturned by God, says the Lord, so no man will be living in it, and no son of man will have a resting-place there.

title: Jeremiah 50:41
text: See, a people is coming from the north; a great nation and a number of kings will be put in motion from the inmost parts of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 50:42
text: Bows and spears are in their hands; they are cruel and have no mercy; their voice is like the thunder of the sea, and they go on horses; everyone in his place like men going to the fight, against you, O daughter of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 50:43
text: The king of Babylon has had news of them, and his hands have become feeble: trouble has come on him and pain like the pain of a woman in childbirth.

title: Jeremiah 50:44
text: See, he will come up like a lion from the thick growth of Jordan against the resting-place of Teman: but I will suddenly make them go in flight from her; and I will put over her the man of my selection: for who is like me? and who will put forward his cause against me? and what keeper of sheep will keep his place before me?

title: Jeremiah 50:45
text: So give ear to the decision of the Lord which he has made against Babylon, and to his purposes designed against the land of the Chaldaeans; Truly, they will be pulled away by the smallest of the flock; truly, he will make waste their fields with them.

title: Jeremiah 50:46
text: At the cry, Babylon is taken! the earth is shaking, and the cry comes to the ears of the nations.

title: Jeremiah 51:1
text: ¶The Lord has said: See, I will make a wind of destruction come up against Babylon and against those who are living in Chaldaea;

title: Jeremiah 51:2
text: And I will send men to Babylon to make her clean and get her land cleared: for in the day of trouble they will put up their tents against her on every side.

title: Jeremiah 51:3
text: Against her the bow of the archer is bent, and he puts on his coat of metal: have no mercy on her young men, give all her army up to the curse.

title: Jeremiah 51:4
text: And the dead will be stretched out in the land of the Chaldaeans, and the wounded in her streets.

title: Jeremiah 51:5
text: For Israel has not been given up, or Judah, by his God, by the Lord of armies; for their land is full of sin against the Holy One of Israel.

title: Jeremiah 51:6
text: Go in flight out of Babylon, so that every man may keep his life; do not be cut off in her evil-doing: for it is the time of the Lord's punishment; he will give her her reward.

title: Jeremiah 51:7
text: Babylon has been a gold cup in the hand of the Lord, which has made all the earth overcome with wine: the nations have taken of her wine, and for this cause the nations have gone off their heads.

title: Jeremiah 51:8
text: Sudden is the downfall of Babylon and her destruction: make cries of grief for her; take sweet oil for her pain, if it is possible for her to be made well.

title: Jeremiah 51:9
text: We would have made Babylon well, but she is not made well: give her up, and let us go everyone to his country: for her punishment is stretching up to heaven, and lifted up even to the skies.

title: Jeremiah 51:10
text: The Lord has made clear our righteousness: come, and let us give an account in Zion of the work of the Lord our God.

title: Jeremiah 51:11
text: Make bright the arrows; take up the body-covers: the Lord has been moving the spirit of the king of the Medes; because his design against Babylon is its destruction: for it is the punishment from the Lord, the payment for his Temple.

title: Jeremiah 51:12
text: Let the flag be lifted up against the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, put the watchmen in their places, make ready a surprise attack: for it is the Lord's purpose, and he has done what he said about the people of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 51:13
text: O you whose living-place is by the wide waters, whose stores are great, your end is come, your evil profit is ended.

title: Jeremiah 51:14
text: The Lord of armies has taken an oath by himself, saying, Truly, I will make you full with men as with locusts, and their voices will be loud against you.

title: Jeremiah 51:15
text: He has made the earth by his power, he has made the world strong in its place by his wisdom, and by his wise design the heavens have been stretched out:

title: Jeremiah 51:16
text: At the sound of his voice there is a massing of the waters in the heavens, and he makes the mists go up from the ends of the earth; he makes the thunder-flames for the rain and sends out the wind from his store-houses.

title: Jeremiah 51:17
text: Then every man becomes like a beast without knowledge; every gold-worker is put to shame by the image he has made: for his metal image is deceit, and there is no breath in them.

title: Jeremiah 51:18
text: They are nothing, a work of error: in the time of their punishment, destruction will overtake them.

title: Jeremiah 51:19
text: The heritage of Jacob is not like these; for the maker of all things is his heritage: the Lord of armies is his name.

title: Jeremiah 51:20
text: You are my fighting axe and my instrument of war: with you the nations will be broken; with you kingdoms will be broken;

title: Jeremiah 51:21
text: With you the horse and the horseman will be broken; with you the war-carriage and he who goes in it will be broken;

title: Jeremiah 51:22
text: With you man and woman will be broken; with you the old man and the boy will be broken; with you the young man and the virgin will be broken;

title: Jeremiah 51:23
text: With you the keeper of sheep with his flock will be broken, and with you the farmer and his oxen will be broken, and with you captains and rulers will be broken.

title: Jeremiah 51:24
text: And I will give to Babylon, and to all the people of Chaldaea, their reward for all the evil they have done in Zion before your eyes, says the Lord.

title: Jeremiah 51:25
text: See, I am against you, says the Lord, O mountain of destruction, causing the destruction of all the earth: and my hand will be stretched out on you, rolling you down from the rocks, and making you a burned mountain.

title: Jeremiah 51:26
text: And they will not take from you a stone for the angle of a wall or the base of a building; but you will be a waste place for ever, says the Lord.

title: Jeremiah 51:27
text: Let a flag be lifted up in the land, let the horn be sounded among the nations, make the nations ready against her; get the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz together against her, make ready a scribe against her; let the horses come up against her like massed locusts.

title: Jeremiah 51:28
text: Make the nations ready for war against her, the king of the Medes and his rulers and all his captains, and all the land under his rule.

title: Jeremiah 51:29
text: And the land is shaking and in pain: for the purposes of the Lord are fixed, to make the land of Babylon an unpeopled waste.

title: Jeremiah 51:30
text: Babylon's men of war have kept back from the fight, waiting in their strong places; their strength has given way, they have become like women: her houses have been put on fire, her locks are broken.

title: Jeremiah 51:31
text: One man, running, will give word to another, and one who goes with news will be handing it on to another, to give word to the king of Babylon that his town has been taken from every quarter:

title: Jeremiah 51:32
text: And the ways across the river have been taken, and the water-holes...burned with fire, and the men of war are in the grip of fear.

title: Jeremiah 51:33
text: For these are the words of the Lord of armies, the God of Israel: The daughter of Babylon is like a grain-floor when it is stamped down; before long, the time of her grain-cutting will come.

title: Jeremiah 51:34
text: Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, has made a meal of me, violently crushing me, he has made me a vessel with nothing in it, he has taken me in his mouth like a dragon, he has made his stomach full with my delicate flesh, crushing me with his teeth.

title: Jeremiah 51:35
text: May the violent things done to me, and my downfall, come on Babylon, the daughter of Zion will say; and, May my blood be on the people of Chaldaea, Jerusalem will say.

title: Jeremiah 51:36
text: For this reason the Lord has said: See, I will give support to your cause, and take payment for what you have undergone; I will make her sea dry, and her fountain without water.

title: Jeremiah 51:37
text: And Babylon will become a mass of broken walls, a hole for jackals, a cause of wonder and surprise, without a living man in it.

title: Jeremiah 51:38
text: They will be crying out together like lions, their voices will be like the voices of young lions.

title: Jeremiah 51:39
text: When they are heated, I will make a feast for them, and overcome them with wine, so that they may become unconscious, sleeping an eternal sleep without awaking, says the Lord.

title: Jeremiah 51:40
text: I will make them go down to death like lambs, like he-goats together.

title: Jeremiah 51:41
text: How is Babylon taken! and the praise of all the earth surprised! how has Babylon become a cause of wonder among the nations!

title: Jeremiah 51:42
text: The sea has come up over Babylon; she is covered with the mass of its waves.

title: Jeremiah 51:43
text: Her towns have become a waste, a dry and unwatered land, where no man has his living-place and no son of man goes by.

title: Jeremiah 51:44
text: And I will send punishment on Bel in Babylon, and take out of his mouth what went into it; no longer will the nations be flowing together to him: truly, the wall of Babylon will come down.

title: Jeremiah 51:45
text: My people, go out from her, and let every man get away safe from the burning wrath of the Lord.

title: Jeremiah 51:46
text: So that your hearts may not become feeble and full of fear because of the news which will go about in the land; for a story will go about one year, and after that in another year another story, and violent acts in the land, ruler against ruler.

title: Jeremiah 51:47
text: For this cause, truly, the days are coming when I will send punishment on the images of Babylon, and all her land will be shamed, and her dead will be falling down in her.

title: Jeremiah 51:48
text: And the heaven and the earth and everything in them, will make a song of joy over Babylon: for those who make her waste will come from the north, says the Lord.

title: Jeremiah 51:49
text: As Babylon had the dead of Israel put to the sword, so in Babylon the dead of all the land will be stretched out.

title: Jeremiah 51:50
text: You who have got away safe from the sword, go, waiting for nothing; have the Lord in memory when you are far away, and keep Jerusalem in mind.

title: Jeremiah 51:51
text: We are shamed because bitter words have come to our ears; our faces are covered with shame: for men from strange lands have come into the holy places of the Lord's house.

title: Jeremiah 51:52
text: For this reason, see, the days are coming, says the Lord, when I will send punishment on her images; and through all her land the wounded will be crying out in pain.

title: Jeremiah 51:53
text: Even if Babylon was lifted up to heaven, even if she had the high places of her strength shut in with walls, still I would send against her those who will make her waste, says the Lord.

title: Jeremiah 51:54
text: There is the sound of a cry from Babylon, and of a great destruction from the land of the Chaldaeans:

title: Jeremiah 51:55
text: For the Lord is making Babylon waste, and putting an end to the great voice coming out of her; and her waves are thundering like great waters, their voice is sounding loud:

title: Jeremiah 51:56
text: For the waster has come on her, even on Babylon, and her men of war are taken, their bows are broken: for the Lord is a rewarding God, and he will certainly give payment.

title: Jeremiah 51:57
text: And I will make her chiefs and her wise men, her rulers and her captains and her men of war, overcome with wine; their sleep will be an eternal sleep without awaking, says the King; the Lord of armies is his name.

title: Jeremiah 51:58
text: The Lord of armies has said: The wide walls of Babylon will be completely uncovered and her high doorways will be burned with fire; so peoples keep on working for nothing, and the weariness of nations comes to an end in the smoke.

title: Jeremiah 51:59
text: ¶The order which Jeremiah the prophet gave to Seraiah, the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah, the king of Judah, to Babylon in the fourth year of his rule. Now Seraiah was the chief controller of the house.

title: Jeremiah 51:60
text: And Jeremiah put in a book all the evil which was to come on Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 51:61
text: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When you come to Babylon, see that you give them all these words;

title: Jeremiah 51:62
text: And after reading them, say, O Lord, you have said about this place that it is to be cut off, so that no one will be living in it, not a man or a beast, but it will be unpeopled for ever.

title: Jeremiah 51:63
text: And it will be that, when you have come to an end of reading this book, you are to have a stone fixed to it, and have it dropped into the Euphrates:

title: Jeremiah 51:64
text: And you are to say, So Babylon will go down, never to be lifted up again, because of the evil which I will send on her: and weariness will overcome them. So far, these are the words of Jeremiah.

title: Jeremiah 52:1
text: ¶Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king; he was king for eleven years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

title: Jeremiah 52:2
text: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as Jehoiakim had done.

title: Jeremiah 52:3
text: And because of the wrath of the Lord this came about in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had sent them away from before him: and Zedekiah took up arms against the king of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 52:4
text: And in the ninth year of his rule, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, came against Jerusalem with all his army and took up his position before it, building earthworks all round it.

title: Jeremiah 52:5
text: So the town was shut in by their forces till the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

title: Jeremiah 52:6
text: In the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month, the store of food in the town was almost gone, so that there was no food for the people of the land.

title: Jeremiah 52:7
text: Then an opening was made in the wall of the town, and all the men of war went in flight out of the town by night through the doorway between the two walls which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldaeans were stationed round the town:) and they went by the way of the Arabah.

title: Jeremiah 52:8
text: And the Chaldaean army went after King Zedekiah and overtook him on the other side of Jericho, and all his army went in flight from him in every direction.

title: Jeremiah 52:9
text: Then they made the king a prisoner and took him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath to be judged.

title: Jeremiah 52:10
text: And the king of Babylon put the sons of Zedekiah to death before his eyes: and he put to death all the rulers of Judah in Riblah.

title: Jeremiah 52:11
text: And he put out Zedekiah's eyes; and the king of Babylon, chaining him in iron bands, took him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

title: Jeremiah 52:12
text: ¶Now in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month, in the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, a servant of the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 52:13
text: And he had the house of the Lord and the king's house and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, burned with fire:

title: Jeremiah 52:14
text: And the walls round Jerusalem were broken down by the Chaldaean army which was with the captain.

title: Jeremiah 52:15
text: Then Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, took away as prisoners the rest of the people who were still in the town, and those who had given themselves up to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the workmen.

title: Jeremiah 52:16
text: But Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, let the poorest of the land go on living there, to take care of the vines and the fields.

title: Jeremiah 52:17
text: And the brass pillars which were in the house of the Lord, and the wheeled bases and the great brass water-vessel in the house of the Lord, were broken up by the Chaldaeans, who took all the brass away to Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 52:18
text: And the pots and the spades and the scissors for the lights and the spoons, and all the brass vessels used in the Lord's house, they took away.

title: Jeremiah 52:19
text: And the cups and the fire-trays and the basins and the pots and the supports for the lights and the spoons and the wide basins; the gold of the gold vessels, and the silver of the silver vessels, the captain of the armed men took away.

title: Jeremiah 52:20
text: The two pillars, the great water-vessel, and the twelve brass oxen which were under it, and the ten wheeled bases, which King Solomon had made for the house of the Lord: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

title: Jeremiah 52:21
text: And as for the pillars, one pillar was eighteen cubits high, and twelve cubits measured all round, and it was as thick as a man's hand: it was hollow.

title: Jeremiah 52:22
text: And there was a crown of brass on it: the crown was five cubits high, circled with a network and apples all of brass; and the second pillar had the same.

title: Jeremiah 52:23
text: There were ninety-six apples on the outside; the number of apples all round the network was a hundred.

title: Jeremiah 52:24
text: ¶And the captain of the armed men took Seraiah, the chief priest, and Zephaniah, the second priest, and the three door-keepers;

title: Jeremiah 52:25
text: And from the town he took the unsexed servant who was over the men of war, and seven of the king's near friends who were in the town, and the scribe of the captain of the army, who was responsible for getting the people of the land together in military order, and sixty men of the people of the land who were in the town.

title: Jeremiah 52:26
text: These Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, took with him to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

title: Jeremiah 52:27
text: And the king of Babylon put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was taken prisoner away from his land.

title: Jeremiah 52:28
text: These are the people whom Nebuchadrezzar took away prisoner: in the seventh year, three thousand and twenty-three Jews:

title: Jeremiah 52:29
text: And in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he took away as prisoners from Jerusalem eight hundred and thirty-two persons:

title: Jeremiah 52:30
text: In the twenty-third year of Nebuchadrezzar, Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, took away as prisoners seven hundred and forty-five of the Jews: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.

title: Jeremiah 52:31
text: ¶And in the thirty-seventh year after Jehoiachin, king of Judah, had been taken prisoner, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-fifth day of the month, Evil-merodach, king of Babylon, in the first year after he became king, took Jehoiachin, king of Judah, out of prison.

title: Jeremiah 52:32
text: And he said kind words to him and put his seat higher than the seats of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 52:33
text: And his prison clothing was changed, and he was a guest at the king's table every day for the rest of his life.

title: Jeremiah 52:34
text: And for his food, the king gave him a regular amount every day till the day of his death, for the rest of his life.

title: Lamentations 1:1
text: ¶See her seated by herself, the town which was full of people! She who was great among the nations has become like a widow! She who was a princess among the countries has come under the yoke of forced work!

title: Lamentations 1:2
text: She is sorrowing bitterly in the night, and her face is wet with weeping; among all her lovers she has no comforter: all her friends have been false to her, they have become her haters.

title: Lamentations 1:3
text: Judah has been taken away as a prisoner because of trouble and hard work; her living-place is among the nations, there is no rest for her: all her attackers have overtaken her in a narrow place.

title: Lamentations 1:4
text: The ways of Zion are sad, because no one comes to the holy meeting; all her doorways are made waste, her priests are breathing out sorrow: her virgins are troubled, and it is bitter for her.

title: Lamentations 1:5
text: Those who are against her have become the head, everything goes well for her haters; for the Lord has sent sorrow on her because of the great number of her sins: her young children have gone away as prisoners before the attacker.

title: Lamentations 1:6
text: And all her glory has gone from the daughter of Zion: her rulers have become like harts with no place for food, and they have gone in flight without strength before the attacker.

title: Lamentations 1:7
text: Jerusalem keeps in mind, in the days of her sorrow and of her wanderings, all the desired things which were hers in days gone by; when her people came into the power of her hater and she had no helper, her attackers saw their desire effected on her and made sport of her destruction.

title: Lamentations 1:8
text: Great is the sin of Jerusalem; for this cause she has become an unclean thing: all those who gave her honour are looking down on her, because they have seen her shame: now truly, breathing out grief, she is turned back.

title: Lamentations 1:9
text: In her skirts were her unclean ways; she gave no thought to her end; and her fall has been a wonder; she has no comforter: see her sorrow, O Lord; for the attacker is lifted up.

title: Lamentations 1:10
text: The hand of her hater is stretched out over all her desired things; for she has seen that the nations have come into her holy place, about whom you gave orders that they were not to come into the meeting of your people.

title: Lamentations 1:11
text: Breathing out grief all her people are looking for bread; they have given their desired things for food to give them life: see, O Lord, and take note; for she has become a thing of shame.

title: Lamentations 1:12
text: ¶Come to me, all you who go by! Keep your eyes on me, and see if there is any pain like the pain of my wound, which the Lord has sent on me in the day of his burning wrath.

title: Lamentations 1:13
text: From on high he has sent fire into my bones, and it has overcome them: his net is stretched out for my feet, I am turned back by him; he has made me waste and feeble all the day.

title: Lamentations 1:14
text: A watch is kept on my sins; they are joined together by his hand, they have come on to my neck; he has made my strength give way: the Lord has given me up into the hands of those against whom I have no power.

title: Lamentations 1:15
text: The Lord has made sport of all my men of war in me, he has got men together against me to send destruction on my young men: the virgin daughter of Judah has been crushed like grapes under the feet of the Lord.

title: Lamentations 1:16
text: For these things I am weeping; my eye is streaming with water; because the comforter who might give me new life is far from me: my children are made waste, because the hater is strong.

title: Lamentations 1:17
text: Zion's hands are outstretched; she has no comforter; the Lord has given orders to the attackers of Jacob round about him: Jerusalem has become like an unclean thing among them.

title: Lamentations 1:18
text: The Lord is upright; for I have gone against his orders: give ear, now, all you peoples, and see my pain, my virgins and my young men have gone away as prisoners.

title: Lamentations 1:19
text: I sent for my lovers, but they were false to me: my priests and my responsible men were breathing their last breath in the town, while they were looking for food to give them new life.

title: Lamentations 1:20
text: See, O Lord, for I am in trouble; the inmost parts of my body are deeply moved; my heart is turned in me; for I have been uncontrolled: outside the children are put to the sword, and in the house there is death.

title: Lamentations 1:21
text: Give ear to the voice of my grief; I have no comforter; all my haters have news of my troubles, they are glad because you have done it: let the day of fate come when they will be like me.

title: Lamentations 1:22
text: Let all their evil-doing come before you; do to them as you have done to me for all my sins: for loud is the sound of my grief, and the strength of my heart is gone.

title: Lamentations 2:1
text: ¶How has the daughter of Zion been covered with a cloud by the Lord in his wrath! he has sent down from heaven to earth the glory of Israel, and has not kept in memory the resting-place of his feet in the day of his wrath.

title: Lamentations 2:2
text: The Lord has given up to destruction all the living-places of Jacob without pity; pulling down in his wrath the strong places of the daughter of Judah, stretching out on the earth the wounded, even her king and her rulers.

title: Lamentations 2:3
text: In his burning wrath every horn of Israel has been cut off; his right hand has been turned back before the attacker: he has put a fire in Jacob, causing destruction round about.

title: Lamentations 2:4
text: His bow has been bent for the attack, he has taken his place with his hand ready, in his hate he has put to death all who were pleasing to the eye: on the tent of the daughter of Zion he has let loose his passion like fire.

title: Lamentations 2:5
text: The Lord has become like one fighting against her, sending destruction on Israel; he has sent destruction on all her great houses, making waste his strong places: increasing the grief and the sorrow of the daughter of Judah.

title: Lamentations 2:6
text: And he has violently taken away his tent, as from a garden; he has made waste his meeting-place: the Lord has taken away the memory of feast and Sabbath in Zion, and in the passion of his wrath he is against king and priest.

title: Lamentations 2:7
text: The Lord has given up his altar and has been turned in hate from his holy place; he has given up into the hands of the attacker the walls of her great houses: their voices have been loud in the house of the Lord as in the day of a holy meeting.

title: Lamentations 2:8
text: It is the Lord's purpose to make waste the wall of the daughter of Zion; his line has been stretched out, he has not kept back his hand from destruction: he has sent sorrow on tower and wall, they have become feeble together.

title: Lamentations 2:9
text: Her doors have gone down into the earth; he has sent destruction on her locks: her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not; even her prophets have had no vision from the Lord.

title: Lamentations 2:10
text: ¶The responsible men of the daughter of Zion are seated on the earth without a word; they have put dust on their heads, they are clothed in haircloth: the heads of the virgins of Jerusalem are bent down to the earth.

title: Lamentations 2:11
text: My eyes are wasted with weeping, the inmost parts of my body are deeply moved, my inner parts are drained out on the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because of the young children and babies at the breast who are falling without strength in the open squares of the town.

title: Lamentations 2:12
text: They say to their mothers, Where is grain and wine? when they are falling like the wounded in the open squares of the town, when their life is drained out on their mother's breast.

title: Lamentations 2:13
text: What example am I to give you? what comparison am I to make for you, O daughter of Jerusalem? what am I to make equal to you, so that I may give you comfort, O virgin daughter of Zion? for your destruction is great like the sea: who is able to make you well?

title: Lamentations 2:14
text: The visions which your prophets have seen for you are false and foolish; they have not made clear to you your sin so that your fate might be changed: but they have seen for you false words, driving you away.

title: Lamentations 2:15
text: All who go by make a noise with their hands at you; they make hisses, shaking their heads at the daughter of Jerusalem, and saying, Is this the town which was the crown of everything beautiful, the joy of all the earth?

title: Lamentations 2:16
text: All your haters are opening their mouths wide against you; making hisses and whistling through their teeth, they say, We have made a meal of her: certainly this is the day we have been looking for; it has come, we have seen it.

title: Lamentations 2:17
text: The Lord has done that which was his purpose; he has put into force the orders which he gave in the days which are past; pulling down without pity, he has made your hater glad over you, lifting up the horn of those who were against you.

title: Lamentations 2:18
text: Let your cry go up to the Lord: O wall of the daughter of Zion, let your weeping be flowing down like a stream day and night; give yourself no rest, let not your eyes keep back the drops of sorrow.

title: Lamentations 2:19
text: Up! give cries in the night, at the starting of the night-watches; let your heart be flowing out like water before the face of the Lord, lifting up your hands to him for the life of your young children who are falling down, feeble for need of food, at the top of every street.

title: Lamentations 2:20
text: Look! O Lord, see to whom you have done this! Are the women to take as their food the fruit of their bodies, the children who are folded in their arms? are the priest and the prophet to be put to death in the holy place of the Lord?

title: Lamentations 2:21
text: The young men and the old are stretched on the earth in the streets; my virgins and my young men have been put to the sword: you have sent death on them in the day of your wrath, causing death without pity.

title: Lamentations 2:22
text: As in the day of a holy meeting you have made fears come round me on every side, and no one got away or was kept safe in the day of the Lord's wrath: those who were folded in my arms, whom I took care of, have been sent to their destruction by my hater.

title: Lamentations 3:1
text: ¶I am the man who has seen trouble by the rod of his wrath.

title: Lamentations 3:2
text: By him I have been made to go in the dark where there is no light.

title: Lamentations 3:3
text: Truly against me his hand has been turned again and again all the day.

title: Lamentations 3:4
text: My flesh and my skin have been used up by him and my bones broken.

title: Lamentations 3:5
text: He has put up a wall against me, shutting me in with bitter sorrow.

title: Lamentations 3:6
text: He has kept me in dark places, like those who have been long dead.

title: Lamentations 3:7
text: He has put a wall round me, so that I am not able to go out; he has made great the weight of my chain.

title: Lamentations 3:8
text: Even when I send up a cry for help, he keeps my prayer shut out.

title: Lamentations 3:9
text: He has put up a wall of cut stones about my ways, he has made my roads twisted.

title: Lamentations 3:10
text: He is like a bear waiting for me, like a lion in secret places.

title: Lamentations 3:11
text: By him my ways have been turned on one side and I have been pulled in bits; he has made me waste.

title: Lamentations 3:12
text: With his bow bent, he has made me the mark for his arrows.

title: Lamentations 3:13
text: He has let loose his arrows into the inmost parts of my body.

title: Lamentations 3:14
text: I have become the sport of all the peoples; I am their song all the day.

title: Lamentations 3:15
text: He has made my life nothing but pain, he has given me the bitter root in full measure.

title: Lamentations 3:16
text: By him my teeth have been broken with crushed stones, and I am bent low in the dust.

title: Lamentations 3:17
text: My soul is sent far away from peace, I have no more memory of good.

title: Lamentations 3:18
text: And I said, My strength is cut off, and my hope from the Lord.

title: Lamentations 3:19
text: Keep in mind my trouble and my wandering, the bitter root and the poison.

title: Lamentations 3:20
text: My soul still keeps the memory of them; and is bent down in me.

title: Lamentations 3:21
text: ¶This I keep in mind, and because of this I have hope.

title: Lamentations 3:22
text: It is through the Lord's love that we have not come to destruction, because his mercies have no limit.

title: Lamentations 3:23
text: They are new every morning; great is your good faith.

title: Lamentations 3:24
text: I said to myself, The Lord is my heritage; and because of this I will have hope in him.

title: Lamentations 3:25
text: The Lord is good to those who are waiting for him, to the soul which is looking for him.

title: Lamentations 3:26
text: It is good to go on hoping and quietly waiting for the salvation of the Lord.

title: Lamentations 3:27
text: It is good for a man to undergo the yoke when he is young.

title: Lamentations 3:28
text: Let him be seated by himself, saying nothing, because he has put it on him.

title: Lamentations 3:29
text: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if by chance there may be hope.

title: Lamentations 3:30
text: Let his face be turned to him who gives him blows; let him be full of shame.

title: Lamentations 3:31
text: For the Lord does not give a man up for ever.

title: Lamentations 3:32
text: For though he sends grief, still he will have pity in the full measure of his love.

title: Lamentations 3:33
text: For he has no pleasure in troubling and causing grief to the children of men.

title: Lamentations 3:34
text: In a man's crushing under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

title: Lamentations 3:35
text: In his turning away the right of a man before the face of the Most High.

title: Lamentations 3:36
text: In his doing wrong to a man in his cause, the Lord has no pleasure.

title: Lamentations 3:37
text: ¶Who is able to say a thing, and give effect to it, if it has not been ordered by the Lord?

title: Lamentations 3:38
text: Do not evil and good come from the mouth of the Most High?

title: Lamentations 3:39
text: What protest may a living man make, even a man about the punishment of his sin?

title: Lamentations 3:40
text: Let us make search and put our ways to the test, turning again to the Lord;

title: Lamentations 3:41
text: Lifting up our hearts with our hands to God in the heavens.

title: Lamentations 3:42
text: ¶We have done wrong and gone against your law; we have not had your forgiveness.

title: Lamentations 3:43
text: Covering yourself with wrath you have gone after us, cutting us off without pity;

title: Lamentations 3:44
text: Covering yourself with a cloud, so that prayer may not get through.

title: Lamentations 3:45
text: You have made us like waste and that for which there is no use, among the peoples.

title: Lamentations 3:46
text: The mouths of all our haters are open wide against us.

title: Lamentations 3:47
text: Fear and deep waters have come on us, wasting and destruction.

title: Lamentations 3:48
text: Rivers of water are running down from my eyes, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

title: Lamentations 3:49
text: My eyes are streaming without stopping, they have no rest,

title: Lamentations 3:50
text: Till the Lord's eye is turned on me, till he sees my trouble from heaven.

title: Lamentations 3:51
text: The Lord is unkind to my soul, more than all the daughters of my town.

title: Lamentations 3:52
text: They who are against me without cause have gone hard after me as if I was a bird;

title: Lamentations 3:53
text: They have put an end to my life in the prison, stoning me with stones.

title: Lamentations 3:54
text: Waters were flowing over my head; I said, I am cut off.

title: Lamentations 3:55
text: ¶I was making prayer to your name, O Lord, out of the lowest prison.

title: Lamentations 3:56
text: My voice came to you; let not your ear be shut to my breathing, to my cry.

title: Lamentations 3:57
text: You came near in the day when I made my prayer to you: you said, Have no fear.

title: Lamentations 3:58
text: O Lord, you have taken up the cause of my soul, you have made my life safe.

title: Lamentations 3:59
text: O Lord, you have seen my wrong; be judge in my cause.

title: Lamentations 3:60
text: You have seen all the evil rewards they have sent on me, and all their designs against me.

title: Lamentations 3:61
text: Their bitter words have come to your ears, O Lord, and all their designs against me;

title: Lamentations 3:62
text: The lips of those who came up against me, and their thoughts against me all the day.

title: Lamentations 3:63
text: Take note of them when they are seated, and when they get up; I am their song.

title: Lamentations 3:64
text: You will give them their reward, O Lord, answering to the work of their hands.

title: Lamentations 3:65
text: You will let their hearts be covered over with your curse on them.

title: Lamentations 3:66
text: You will go after them in wrath, and put an end to them from under the heavens of the Lord.

title: Lamentations 4:1
text: ¶How dark has the gold become! how changed the best gold! the stones of the holy place are dropping out at the top of every street.

title: Lamentations 4:2
text: The valued sons of Zion, whose price was the best gold, are looked on as vessels of earth, the work of the hands of the potter!

title: Lamentations 4:3
text: Even the beasts of the waste land have full breasts, they give milk to their young ones: the daughter of my people has become cruel like the ostriches in the waste land.

title: Lamentations 4:4
text: The tongue of the child at the breast is fixed to the roof of his mouth for need of drink: the young children are crying out for bread, and no man gives it to them.

title: Lamentations 4:5
text: Those who were used to feasting on delicate food are wasted in the streets: those who as children were dressed in purple are stretched out on the dust.

title: Lamentations 4:6
text: For the punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of Sodom, which was overturned suddenly without any hand falling on her.

title: Lamentations 4:7
text: Her holy ones were cleaner than snow, they were whiter than milk, their bodies were redder than corals, their form was as the sapphire:

title: Lamentations 4:8
text: Their face is blacker than night; in the streets no one has knowledge of them: their skin is hanging on their bones, they are dry, they have become like wood.

title: Lamentations 4:9
text: Those who have been put to the sword are better off than those whose death is caused by need of food; for these come to death slowly, burned up like the fruit of the field.

title: Lamentations 4:10
text: The hands of kind-hearted women have been boiling their children; they were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

title: Lamentations 4:11
text: The Lord has given full effect to his passion, he has let loose his burning wrath; he has made a fire in Zion, causing the destruction of its bases.

title: Lamentations 4:12
text: To the kings of the earth and to all the people of the world it did not seem possible that the attackers and the haters would go into the doors of Jerusalem.

title: Lamentations 4:13
text: ¶It is because of the sins of her prophets and the evil-doing of her priests, by whom the blood of the upright has been drained out in her.

title: Lamentations 4:14
text: They are wandering like blind men in the streets, they are made unclean with blood, so that their robes may not be touched by men.

title: Lamentations 4:15
text: Away! unclean! they were crying out to them, Away! away! let there be no touching: when they went away in flight and wandering, men said among the nations, There is no further resting-place for them.

title: Lamentations 4:16
text: The face of the Lord has sent them in all directions; he will no longer take care of them: they had no respect for the priests, they gave no honour to the old men.

title: Lamentations 4:17
text: Our eyes are still wasting away in looking for our false help: we have been watching for a nation unable to give salvation.

title: Lamentations 4:18
text: They go after our steps so that we may not go in our streets: our end is near, our days are numbered; for our end has come.

title: Lamentations 4:19
text: Those who went after us were quicker than the eagles of the heaven, driving us before them on the mountains, waiting secretly for us in the waste land.

title: Lamentations 4:20
text: Our breath of life, he on whom the holy oil was put, was taken in their holes; of whom we said, Under his shade we will be living among the nations.

title: Lamentations 4:21
text: ¶Have joy and be glad, O daughter of Edom, living in the land of Uz: the cup will be given to you in your turn, and you will be overcome with wine and your shame will be seen.

title: Lamentations 4:22
text: The punishment of your evil-doing is complete, O daughter of Zion; never again will he take you away as a prisoner: he will give you the reward of your evil-doing, O daughter of Edom; he will let your sin be uncovered.

title: Lamentations 5:1
text: ¶Keep in mind, O Lord, what has come to us: take note and see our shame.

title: Lamentations 5:2
text: Our heritage is given up to men of strange lands, our houses to those who are not our countrymen.

title: Lamentations 5:3
text: We are children without fathers, our mothers are like widows.

title: Lamentations 5:4
text: We give money for a drink of water, we get our wood for a price.

title: Lamentations 5:5
text: Our attackers are on our necks: overcome with weariness, we have no rest.

title: Lamentations 5:6
text: We have given our hands to the Egyptians and to the Assyrians so that we might have enough bread.

title: Lamentations 5:7
text: Our fathers were sinners and are dead; and the weight of their evil-doing is on us.

title: Lamentations 5:8
text: Servants are ruling over us, and there is no one to make us free from their hands.

title: Lamentations 5:9
text: We put our lives in danger to get our bread, because of the sword of the waste land.

title: Lamentations 5:10
text: Our skin is heated like an oven because of our burning heat from need of food.

title: Lamentations 5:11
text: They took by force the women in Zion, the virgins in the towns of Judah.

title: Lamentations 5:12
text: Their hands put princes to death by hanging: the faces of old men were not honoured.

title: Lamentations 5:13
text: The young men were crushing the grain, and the boys were falling under the wood.

title: Lamentations 5:14
text: The old men are no longer seated in the doorway, and the music of the young men has come to an end.

title: Lamentations 5:15
text: The joy of our hearts is ended; our dancing is changed into sorrow.

title: Lamentations 5:16
text: The crown has been taken from our head: sorrow is ours, for we are sinners.

title: Lamentations 5:17
text: ¶Because of this our hearts are feeble; for these things our eyes are dark;

title: Lamentations 5:18
text: Because of the mountain of Zion which is a waste; jackals go over it.

title: Lamentations 5:19
text: You, O Lord, are seated as King for ever; the seat of your power is eternal.

title: Lamentations 5:20
text: Why have we gone from your memory for ever? why have you been turned away from us for so long?

title: Lamentations 5:21
text: Make us come back to you, O Lord, and let us be turned; make our days new again as in the past.

title: Lamentations 5:22
text: But you have quite given us up; you are full of wrath against us.

title: Ezekiel 1:1
text: ¶Now it came about in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, while I was by the river Chebar among those who had been made prisoners, that the heavens were made open and I saw visions of God.

title: Ezekiel 1:2
text: On the fifth day of the month, in the fifth year after King Jehoiachin had been made a prisoner,

title: Ezekiel 1:3
text: The word of the Lord came to me, Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldaeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the Lord was on me there.

title: Ezekiel 1:4
text: ¶And, looking, I saw a storm-wind coming out of the north, a great cloud with flames of fire coming after one another, and a bright light shining round about it and in the heart of it was something coloured like electrum.

title: Ezekiel 1:5
text: And in the heart of it were the forms of four living beings. And this was what they were like; they had the form of a man.

title: Ezekiel 1:6
text: And every one had four faces, and every one of them had four wings.

title: Ezekiel 1:7
text: And their feet were straight feet; and the under sides of their feet were like the feet of oxen; and they were shining like polished brass.

title: Ezekiel 1:8
text: And they had the hands of a man under their wings; the four of them had faces on their four sides.

title: Ezekiel 1:9
text: They went without turning, every one went straight forward.

title: Ezekiel 1:10
text: As for the form of their faces, they had the face of a man, and the four of them had the face of a lion on the right side, and the four of them had the face of an ox on the left side, and the four of them had the face of an eagle.

title: Ezekiel 1:11
text: And their wings were separate at the top; two of the wings of every one were joined one to another, and two were covering their bodies.

title: Ezekiel 1:12
text: Every one of them went straight forward; wherever the spirit was to go they went; they went on without turning.

title: Ezekiel 1:13
text: And between the living beings it was like burning coals of fire, as if flames were going one after the other between the living beings; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went thunder-flames.

title: Ezekiel 1:14
text: And the living beings went out and came back as quickly as a thunder-flame.

title: Ezekiel 1:15
text: ¶Now while I was looking at the four living beings, I saw one wheel on the earth, by the side of the living beings, for the four of them.

title: Ezekiel 1:16
text: The form of the wheels and their work was like a beryl; the four of them had the same form and design, and they were like a wheel inside a wheel.

title: Ezekiel 1:17
text: The four of them went straight forward without turning to one side.

title: Ezekiel 1:18
text: And I saw that they had edges, and their edges, even of the four, were full of eyes round about.

title: Ezekiel 1:19
text: And when the living beings went on, the wheels went by their side; and when the living beings were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

title: Ezekiel 1:20
text: Wherever the spirit was to go they went; and the wheels were lifted up by their side: for the spirit of the living beings was in the wheels.

title: Ezekiel 1:21
text: When these went on, the others went; and when these came to rest, the others came to rest; and when these were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up by their side: for the spirit of the living beings was in the wheels.

title: Ezekiel 1:22
text: And over the heads of the living beings there was the form of an arch, looking like ice, stretched out over their heads on high.

title: Ezekiel 1:23
text: Under the arch their wings were straight, one stretched out to another: every one had two wings covering their bodies on this side and two covering their bodies on that side.

title: Ezekiel 1:24
text: And when they went, the sound of their wings was like the sound of great waters to my ears, like the voice of the Ruler of all, a sound like the rushing of an army: when they came to rest they let down their wings.

title: Ezekiel 1:25
text: And there was a voice from the top of the arch which was over their heads: when they came to rest they let down their wings.

title: Ezekiel 1:26
text: ¶And on the top of the arch which was over their heads was the form of a king's seat, like a sapphire stone; and on the form of the seat was the form of a man seated on it on high.

title: Ezekiel 1:27
text: And I saw it coloured like electrum, with the look of fire in it and round it, going up from what seemed to be the middle of his body; and going down from what seemed to be the middle of his body I saw what was like fire, and there was a bright light shining round him.

title: Ezekiel 1:28
text: Like the bow in the cloud on a day of rain, so was the light shining round him. And this is what the glory of the Lord was like. And when I saw it I went down on my face, and the voice of one talking came to my ears.

title: Ezekiel 2:1
text: ¶And he said to me, Son of man, get up on your feet, so that I may say words to you.

title: Ezekiel 2:2
text: And at his words the spirit came into me and put me on my feet; and his voice came to my ears.

title: Ezekiel 2:3
text: And he said to me, Son of man, I am sending you to the children of Israel, to an uncontrolled nation which has gone against me: they and their fathers have been sinners against me even to this very day.

title: Ezekiel 2:4
text: And the children are hard and stiff-hearted; I am sending you to them: and you are to say to them, These are the words of the Lord.

title: Ezekiel 2:5
text: And they, if they give ear to you or if they do not give ear (for they are an uncontrolled people), will see that there has been a prophet among them.

title: Ezekiel 2:6
text: ¶And you, son of man, have no fear of them or of their words, even if sharp thorns are round you and you are living among scorpions: have no fear of their words and do not be overcome by their looks, for they are an uncontrolled people.

title: Ezekiel 2:7
text: And you are to give them my words, if they give ear to you or if they do not: for they are uncontrolled.

title: Ezekiel 2:8
text: But you, son of man, give ear to what I say to you, and do not be uncontrolled like that uncontrolled people: let your mouth be open and take what I give you.

title: Ezekiel 2:9
text: And looking, I saw a hand stretched out to me, and I saw the roll of a book in it;

title: Ezekiel 2:10
text: And he put it open before me, and it had writing on the front and on the back; words of grief and sorrow and trouble were recorded in it.

title: Ezekiel 3:1
text: ¶And he said to me, Son of man, take this roll for your food, and go and say my words to the children of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 3:2
text: And, on my opening my mouth, he made me take the roll as food.

title: Ezekiel 3:3
text: And he said to me, Son of man, let your stomach make a meal of it and let your inside be full of this roll which I am giving you. Then I took it, and it was sweet as honey in my mouth.

title: Ezekiel 3:4
text: And he said to me, Son of man, go now to the children of Israel, and say my words to them.

title: Ezekiel 3:5
text: For you are not sent to a people whose talk is strange and whose language is hard, but to the children of Israel;

title: Ezekiel 3:6
text: Not to a number of peoples whose talk is strange and whose language is hard and whose words are not clear to you. Truly, if I sent you to them they would give ear to you.

title: Ezekiel 3:7
text: But the children of Israel will not give ear to you; for they have no mind to give ear to me: for all the children of Israel have a hard brow and a stiff heart.

title: Ezekiel 3:8
text: See, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your brow hard against their brows.

title: Ezekiel 3:9
text: Like a diamond harder than rock I have made your brow: have no fear of them and do not be overcome by their looks, for they are an uncontrolled people.

title: Ezekiel 3:10
text: Then he said to me, Son of man, take into your heart all my words which I am about to say to you, and let your ears be open to them.

title: Ezekiel 3:11
text: And go now to those who have been taken away as prisoners, to the children of your people, and say to them, This is what the Lord has said; if they give ear or if they do not.

title: Ezekiel 3:12
text: Then I was lifted up by the wind, and at my back the sound of a great rushing came to my ears when the glory of the Lord was lifted up from his place.

title: Ezekiel 3:13
text: And there was the sound of the wings of the living beings touching one another, and the sound of the wheels at their side, the sound of a great rushing.

title: Ezekiel 3:14
text: And the wind, lifting me up, took me away: and I went in the heat of my spirit, and the hand of the Lord was strong on me.

title: Ezekiel 3:15
text: Then I came to those who had been taken away as prisoners, who were at Telabib by the river Chebar, and I was seated among them full of wonder for seven days.

title: Ezekiel 3:16
text: ¶And at the end of seven days, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 3:17
text: Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the children of Israel: so give ear to the word of my mouth, and give them word from me of their danger.

title: Ezekiel 3:18
text: When I say to the evil-doer, Death will certainly be your fate; and you give him no word of it and say nothing to make clear to the evil-doer the danger of his evil way, so that he may be safe; that same evil man will come to death in his evil-doing; but I will make you responsible for his blood.

title: Ezekiel 3:19
text: But if you give the evil-doer word of his danger, and he is not turned from his sin or from his evil way, death will overtake him in his evil-doing; but your life will be safe.

title: Ezekiel 3:20
text: Again, when an upright man, turning away from his righteousness, does evil, and I put a cause of falling in his way, death will overtake him: because you have given him no word of his danger, death will overtake him in his evil-doing, and there will be no memory of the upright acts which he has done; but I will make you responsible for his blood.

title: Ezekiel 3:21
text: But if you say to the upright man that he is not to do evil, he will certainly keep his life because he took note of your word; and your life will be safe.

title: Ezekiel 3:22
text: ¶And the hand of the Lord was on me there; and he said, Get up and go out into the valley and there I will have talk with you.

title: Ezekiel 3:23
text: Then I got up and went out into the valley; and I saw the glory of the Lord resting there as I had seen it by the river Chebar; and I went down on my face.

title: Ezekiel 3:24
text: Then the spirit came into me and put me on my feet; and he had talk with me and said to me, Go and keep yourself shut up inside your house.

title: Ezekiel 3:25
text: But see, O son of man, I will put bands on you, prisoning you in them, and you will not go out among them:

title: Ezekiel 3:26
text: And I will make your tongue fixed to the roof of your mouth, so that you have no voice and may not make protests to them: for they are an uncontrolled people.

title: Ezekiel 3:27
text: But when I have talk with you I will make your mouth open, and you are to say to them, This is what the Lord has said: Let the hearer give ear; and as for him who will not, let him keep his ears shut: for they are an uncontrolled people.

title: Ezekiel 4:1
text: ¶And you, son of man, take a back and put it before you and on it make a picture of a town, even Jerusalem.

title: Ezekiel 4:2
text: And make an attack on it, shutting it in, building strong places against it, and making high an earthwork against it; and put up tents against it, placing engines all round it for smashing down its walls.

title: Ezekiel 4:3
text: And take a flat iron plate, and put it for a wall of iron between you and the town: and let your face be turned to it, and it will be shut in and you will make an attack on it. This will be a sign to the children of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 4:4
text: Then, stretching yourself out on your left side, take the sin of the children of Israel on yourself: for as long as you are stretched out, so long will the sin of the children of Israel be on you.

title: Ezekiel 4:5
text: For I have had the years of their sin measured for you by a number of days, even three hundred and ninety days: and you will take on yourself the sin of the children of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 4:6
text: And when these days are ended, turning on your right side, you are to take on yourself the sin of the children of Judah: forty days, a day for a year, I have had it fixed for you.

title: Ezekiel 4:7
text: And let your face be turned to where Jerusalem is shut in, with your arm uncovered, and be a prophet against it.

title: Ezekiel 4:8
text: And see, I will put bands on you; and you will be stretched out without turning from one side to the other till the days of your attack are ended.

title: Ezekiel 4:9
text: ¶And take for yourself wheat and barley and different sorts of grain, and put them in one vessel and make bread for yourself from them; all the days when you are stretched on your side it will be your food.

title: Ezekiel 4:10
text: And you are to take your food by weight, twenty shekels a day: you are to take it at regular times.

title: Ezekiel 4:11
text: And you are to take water by measure, the sixth part of a hin: you are to take it at regular times.

title: Ezekiel 4:12
text: And let your food be barley cakes, cooking it before their eyes with the waste which comes out of a man.

title: Ezekiel 4:13
text: And the Lord said, Even so the children of Israel will have unclean bread for their food among the nations where I am driving them.

title: Ezekiel 4:14
text: Then I said, Ah, Lord! see, my soul has never been unclean, and I have never taken as my food anything which has come to a natural death or has been broken by beasts, from the time when I was young even till now; no disgusting flesh has ever come into my mouth.

title: Ezekiel 4:15
text: Then he said to me, See, I have given you cow's waste in place of man's waste, and you will make your bread ready on it.

title: Ezekiel 4:16
text: And he said to me, Son of man, see, I will take away from Jerusalem her necessary bread: they will take their bread by weight and with care, measuring out their drinking-water with fear and wonder:

title: Ezekiel 4:17
text: So that they may be in need of bread and water and be wondering at one another, wasting away in their sin.

title: Ezekiel 5:1
text: ¶And you, son of man, take a sharp sword, using it like a haircutter's blade, and making it go over your head and the hair of your chin: and take scales for separating the hair by weight.

title: Ezekiel 5:2
text: You are to have a third part burned with fire inside the town, when the days of the attack are ended; and a third part you are to take and give blows with the sword round about it; and give a third part for the wind to take away, and let loose a sword after them.

title: Ezekiel 5:3
text: And take from them a small number of hairs, folding them in your skirts.

title: Ezekiel 5:4
text: And again take some of these and put them in the fire, burning them up in the fire; and say to all the children of Israel,

title: Ezekiel 5:5
text: ¶This is what the Lord has said: This is Jerusalem: I have put her among the nations, and countries are round her on every side;

title: Ezekiel 5:6
text: And she has gone against my orders by doing evil more than the nations, and against my rules more than the countries round her: for they have given up my orders, and as for my rules, they have not gone in the way of them.

title: Ezekiel 5:7
text: For this cause the Lord has said: Because you have been more uncontrolled than the nations round about you, and have not been guided by my rules or kept my orders, but have kept the orders of the nations round about you;

title: Ezekiel 5:8
text: For this cause the Lord has said: See, I, even I, am against you; and I will be judging among you before the eyes of the nations.

title: Ezekiel 5:9
text: And I will do in you what I have not done and will not do again, because of all your disgusting ways.

title: Ezekiel 5:10
text: For this cause fathers will take their sons for food among you, and sons will make a meal of their fathers; and I will be judge among you, and all the rest of you I will send away to every wind.

title: Ezekiel 5:11
text: For this cause, by my life, says the Lord, because you have made my holy place unclean with all your hated things and all your disgusting ways, you will become disgusting to me; my eye will have no mercy and I will have no pity.

title: Ezekiel 5:12
text: A third of you will come to death from disease, wasting away among you through need of food; a third will be put to the sword round about you; and a third I will send away to every wind, letting loose a sword after them.

title: Ezekiel 5:13
text: So my wrath will be complete and my passion will come to rest on them; and they will be certain that I the Lord have given the word of decision, when my wrath against them is complete.

title: Ezekiel 5:14
text: And I will make you a waste and a name of shame among the nations round about you, in the eyes of everyone who goes by.

title: Ezekiel 5:15
text: And you will be a name of shame and a cause of bitter words, an example and a wonder to the nations round about you, when I give effect to my judging among you in wrath and in passion and in burning protests: I the Lord have said it:

title: Ezekiel 5:16
text: When I send on you the evil arrows of disease, causing destruction, which I will send to put an end to you; and, further, I will take away your necessary food.

title: Ezekiel 5:17
text: And I will send on you need of food and evil beasts, and they will be a cause of loss to you; and disease and violent death will go through you; and I will send the sword on you: I the Lord have said it.

title: Ezekiel 6:1
text: ¶And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 6:2
text: Son of man, let your face be turned to the mountains of Israel, and be a prophet to them, and say,

title: Ezekiel 6:3
text: You mountains of Israel, give ear to the words of the Lord: this is what the Lord has said to the mountains and the hills, to the waterways and the valleys: See, I, even I, am sending on you a sword for the destruction of your high places.

title: Ezekiel 6:4
text: And your altars will be made waste, and your sun-images will be broken: and I will have your dead men placed before your images.

title: Ezekiel 6:5
text: And I will put the dead bodies of the children of Israel in front of their images, sending your bones in all directions about your altars.

title: Ezekiel 6:6
text: In all your living-places the towns will become broken walls, and the high places made waste; so that your altars may be broken down and made waste, and your images broken and ended, and so that your sun-images may be cut down and your works rubbed out.

title: Ezekiel 6:7
text: And the dead will be falling down among you, and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

title: Ezekiel 6:8
text: ¶But still, I will keep a small band safe from the sword among the nations, when you are sent wandering among the countries.

title: Ezekiel 6:9
text: And those of you who are kept safe will have me in mind among the nations where they have been taken away as prisoners, how I sent punishment on their hearts which were untrue to me, and on their eyes which were turned to their false gods: and they will be full of hate for themselves because of the evil things which they have done in all their disgusting ways.

title: Ezekiel 6:10
text: And they will be certain that I am the Lord: not for nothing did I say that I would do this evil to them.

title: Ezekiel 6:11
text: ¶This is what the Lord has said: Give blows with your hand, stamping with your foot, and say, O sorrow! because of all the evil and disgusting ways of the children of Israel: for death will overtake them by the sword and through need of food and by disease.

title: Ezekiel 6:12
text: He who is far away will come to his death by disease; he who is near will be put to the sword; he who is shut up will come to his death through need of food; and I will give full effect to my passion against them.

title: Ezekiel 6:13
text: And you will be certain that I am the Lord, when their dead men are stretched among their images round about their altars on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, and under every branching tree, and under every thick oak-tree, the places where they made sweet smells to all their images.

title: Ezekiel 6:14
text: And my hand will be stretched out against them, making the land waste and unpeopled, from the waste land to Riblah, through all their living-places: and they will be certain that I am the Lord.

title: Ezekiel 7:1
text: ¶And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 7:2
text: And you, son of man, say, This is what the Lord has said to the land of Israel: An end has come, the end has come on the four quarters of the land.

title: Ezekiel 7:3
text: Now the end has come on you, and I will send my wrath on you, judging you for your ways, I will send punishment on you for all your disgusting acts.

title: Ezekiel 7:4
text: My eye will not have mercy on you, and I will have no pity: but I will send the punishment of your ways on you, and your disgusting works will be among you: and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

title: Ezekiel 7:5
text: This is what the Lord has said: An evil, even one evil; see, it is coming.

title: Ezekiel 7:6
text: An end has come, the end has come; see, it is coming on you.

title: Ezekiel 7:7
text: The crowning time has come on you, O people of the land: the time has come, the day is near; the day will not be slow in coming, it will not keep back.

title: Ezekiel 7:8
text: Now, in a little time, I will let loose my passion on you, and give full effect to my wrath against you, judging you for your ways, and sending punishment on you for all your disgusting works.

title: Ezekiel 7:9
text: My eye will not have mercy, and I will have no pity: I will send on you the punishment of your ways, and your disgusting works will be among you; and you will see that I am the Lord who gives punishment.

title: Ezekiel 7:10
text: See, the day; see, it is coming: the crowning time has gone out; the twisted way is flowering, pride has put out buds.

title: Ezekiel 7:11
text: Violent behaviour has been lifted up into a rod of evil; it will not be slow in coming, it will not keep back.

title: Ezekiel 7:12
text: The time has come, the day is near: let not him who gives a price for goods be glad, or him who gets the price have sorrow:

title: Ezekiel 7:13
text: For the trader will not go back to the things for which he had his price, even while he is still living:

title: Ezekiel 7:14
text: And he who has given a price for goods will not get them, for my wrath is on all of them.

title: Ezekiel 7:15
text: Outside is the sword, and inside disease and need of food: he who is in the open country will be put to the sword; he who is in the town will come to his end through need of food and disease.

title: Ezekiel 7:16
text: ¶And those of them who get away safely will go and be in the secret places like the doves of the valleys, all of them will come to death, every one in his sin.

title: Ezekiel 7:17
text: All hands will be feeble and all knees without strength, like water.

title: Ezekiel 7:18
text: And they will put haircloth round them, and deep fear will be covering them; and shame will be on all faces, and the hair gone from all their heads.

title: Ezekiel 7:19
text: They will put out their silver into the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing; their silver and their gold will not be able to keep them safe in the day of the wrath of the Lord; they will not get their desire or have food for their need: because it has been the cause of their falling into sin.

title: Ezekiel 7:20
text: As for their beautiful ornament, they had put it on high, and had made the images of their disgusting and hated things in it: for this cause I have made it an unclean thing to them.

title: Ezekiel 7:21
text: And I will give it into the hands of men from strange lands who will take it by force, and to the evil-doers of the earth to have for themselves; and they will make it unholy.

title: Ezekiel 7:22
text: And my face will be turned away from them, and they will make my secret place unholy: violent men will go into it and make it unholy.

title: Ezekiel 7:23
text: ¶Make the chain: for the land is full of crimes of blood, and the town is full of violent acts.

title: Ezekiel 7:24
text: For this reason I will send the worst of the nations and they will take their houses for themselves: I will make the pride of their strength come to an end; and their holy places will be made unclean.

title: Ezekiel 7:25
text: Shaking fear is coming; and they will be looking for peace, and there will be no peace.

title: Ezekiel 7:26
text: Destruction will come on destruction, and one story after another; and the vision of the prophet will be shamed, and knowledge of the law will come to an end among the priests, and wisdom among the old.

title: Ezekiel 7:27
text: The king will give himself up to sorrow, and the ruler will be clothed with wonder, and the hands of the people of the land will be troubled: I will give them punishment for their ways, judging them as it is right for them to be judged; and they will be certain that I am the Lord.

title: Ezekiel 8:1
text: ¶Now in the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth day of the month, when I was in my house and the responsible men of Judah were seated before me, the hand of the Lord came on me there.

title: Ezekiel 8:2
text: And looking, I saw a form like fire; from the middle of his body and down there was fire: and up from the middle of his body a sort of shining, like electrum.

title: Ezekiel 8:3
text: And he put out the form of a hand and took me by the hair of my head; and the wind, lifting me up between the earth and the heaven, took me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the way into the inner door facing to the north; where was the seat of the image of envy.

title: Ezekiel 8:4
text: And I saw the glory of the Lord there, as in the vision which I saw in the valley.

title: Ezekiel 8:5
text: Then he said to me, Son of man, now let your eyes be lifted up in the direction of the north; and on looking in the direction of the north, to the north of the doorway of the altar, I saw this image of envy by the way in.

title: Ezekiel 8:6
text: And he said to me, Son of man, do you see what they are doing? even the very disgusting things which the children of Israel are doing here, causing me to go far away from my holy place? but you will see other most disgusting things.

title: Ezekiel 8:7
text: ¶And he took me to the door of the open place; and looking, I saw a hole in the wall.

title: Ezekiel 8:8
text: And he said to me, Son of man, make a hole in the wall: and after making a hole in the wall I saw a door.

title: Ezekiel 8:9
text: And he said to me, Go in and see the evil and disgusting things which they are doing here.

title: Ezekiel 8:10
text: So I went in and saw; and there every sort of living thing which goes flat on the earth, and unclean beasts, and all the images of the children of Israel, were pictured round about on the wall.

title: Ezekiel 8:11
text: And before them seventy of the responsible men of the children of Israel had taken their places, every man with a vessel for burning perfumes in his hand, and in the middle of them was Jaazaniah, the son of Shaphan; and a cloud of smoke went up from the burning perfume.

title: Ezekiel 8:12
text: And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen what the responsible men of the children of Israel do in the dark, every man in his room of pictured images? for they say, The Lord does not see us; the Lord has gone away from the land.

title: Ezekiel 8:13
text: ¶Then he said to me, You will see even more disgusting things which they do.

title: Ezekiel 8:14
text: Then he took me to the door of the way into the Lord's house looking to the north; and there women were seated weeping for Tammuz.

title: Ezekiel 8:15
text: Then he said to me, Have you seen this, O son of man? you will see even more disgusting things than these.

title: Ezekiel 8:16
text: And he took me into the inner square of the Lord's house, and at the door of the Temple of the Lord, between the covered way and the altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs turned to the Temple of the Lord and their faces turned to the east; and they were worshipping the sun, turning to the east.

title: Ezekiel 8:17
